widgets_values:
# FAQ

**How do I use this??**

I'll be posting tutorials on my YouTube channel soon!
<https://www.youtube.com/@WhatDreamsCost/>

**Where do I download these models??**

There is a good list of models and download links here: <https://github.com/wildminder/awesome-ltx2?tab=readme-ov-file>

Also the latest v1.1 spatial upscaler can be found here: <https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/tree/main>

The tiny vae (taeltx2_3.safetensors) is found here:
<https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors>

**I'm getting errors when running this workflow!**

Double check that you have all of the correct models loaded. This is using the newest version of 2x upscaler (v1.1). You can change it to the older one under the Model Loader.

**How can I support you?**

Help me get a job. I'm unemployed and literally broke. (seriously, i'll even scrub toilets for minimum wage)

Or follow me on my socials :)

<https://x.com/WhatDreamsCost>

<https://www.instagram.com/whatdreamscost/>

<https://www.youtube.com/@WhatDreamsCost/>

PREMIERE316 LTX-2.5 SEGMENTED IMAGE-TO-VIDEO — H02-S03-C01

GENERATION MODE
Generate only the selected H02 Corrected V3 picture segment from its declared first frame. Segment 01 begins from the supplied canonical start plate. Segment 02 begins only from the accepted decoded tail of Segment 01. Segment 03 begins only from the accepted decoded tail of Segment 02.

PACKAGE GLOBAL VISUAL / CHRONOLOGY LOCK
Maximum-photorealistic live-action biblical epic; real actors, real anatomy, visible skin pores, real hair, tactile practical ancient linen, practical creature prosthetics, physically photographed basalt and iron, real smoke and ash, natural anamorphic lens behavior, restrained motion blur, high dynamic range and delicate film grain. No cartoon, illustration, painting, glossy CGI, fantasy game render, plastic skin, synthetic fabric, text, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, collages, duplicated people or malformed anatomy.

CORRECTED V3 HANDOFF CONTRACT
Do not use independently supplied SEG02_FIRST or SEG03_FIRST images as frame zero. They are story-intent references only. Export the accepted decoded tail of Segment 01 as SEG02 handoff, and the accepted decoded tail of Segment 02 as SEG03 handoff. Dialogue, intelligible voices and music are added in post.
properties.local_prompts: One continuous six-second live-action 35mm anamorphic shot in the physically built basalt Court of Accusation. Photographed human skin and hair, coarse ancient linen, matte hand-forged iron, practical smoke and ash, restrained ember key light, weak cool rear separation, natural gravity and lens falloff. The same elderly Adam is fixed screen-left to one blackened iron tree by two wrist cuffs and two taut chains, with every anchor visible. The same human-scale Lesser Torturer stands screen-right, planted and silent, holding one short solid hook whose curved tip is dull orange. Begin with the hook tip occupying less than one fifth of the lower-left foreground in focus while Adam is soft behind it. Focus transfers to Adam as a 32mm camera dollies straight backward at one restrained speed, revealing the full tree, both cuffs, both anchors and both figures. Adam takes one shallow breath and pulls once, producing one small heavy-chain tremor. The Torturer remains planted. All described actor and camera motion finishes by 5.5 seconds. The resulting composition remains locked and unchanged through the final twelve frames; only minimal breathing, smoke and sparse ash continue.

One continuous six-second live-action 35mm anamorphic shot in the physically built basalt Court of Accusation. Photographed human skin and hair, coarse ancient linen, matte hand-forged iron, practical smoke and ash, restrained ember key light, weak cool rear separation, natural gravity and lens falloff. The same elderly Adam is fixed screen-left to one blackened iron tree by two wrist cuffs and two taut chains, with every anchor visible. The same human-scale Lesser Torturer stands screen-right, planted and silent, holding one short solid hook whose curved tip is dull orange. Begin with the hook tip occupying less than one fifth of the lower-left foreground in focus while Adam is soft behind it. Focus transfers to Adam as a 32mm camera dollies straight backward at one restrained speed, revealing the full tree, both cuffs, both anchors and both figures. Adam takes one shallow breath and pulls once, producing one small heavy-chain tremor. The Torturer remains planted. All described actor and camera motion finishes by 5.5 seconds. The resulting composition remains locked and unchanged through the final twelve frames; only minimal breathing, smoke and sparse ash continue.
